en.title: Pairs of Processes with Similar Loads
en.description:
Given an array of process loads and a threshold m, count unordered pairs (i,j) of distinct indices whose loads differ by at most m in absolute value. Each pair is counted once; pairs with equal values but different indices are counted too.

The standard input format, examples and test data were written by CSWork.
en.input: The first line contains n m (1≤n≤200000, 0≤m≤10⁸), and the second line contains n loads (1..10⁸). The answer may exceed the range of a 32-bit integer.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer required by the problem.
en.explanation: The valid load pairs in example 1 are (7,10), (10,13), (10,11), (13,11), 4 pairs in total.
hints: Sort the loads and use a left pointer to maintain the range of loads within m of the current right-end load. For each right end, add right−left pairs.
